description: Clear: Customer Experience Manager -> senior seniority
input:
Title: Customer Experience Manager
Company: Brightwave Software
URL: https://brightwave.example/careers/cx-mgr

We're looking for a Customer Experience Manager to own our customer experience strategy. You'll drive NPS improvements and partner with Product to close the feedback loop.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in CX or customer success
- Salesforce Service Cloud expertise
- Experience with NPS/CSAT programs

Compensation: $130,000 - $155,000 + equity
Location: Remote (US)
notes: Manager title + 5+ years -> senior per management-track rules. SaaS company, explicit remote.

description: Edge: Senior Manager, CX -> staff seniority
input:
Title: Senior Manager, Customer Experience
Company: Cloudhaven
URL: https://cloudhaven.example/careers/sr-mgr-cx

Cloudhaven is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience to lead a team of 8 CX specialists. You'll set the CX strategy for our cloud products and manage cross-regional programs.

Requirements:
- 8+ years in CX leadership
- 3+ years managing CX teams
- B2B SaaS experience required

Location: San Francisco (hybrid, 2 days/week)
notes: Senior Manager = staff per management-track rules. Key test: models often classify 'Senior Manager' as just 'senior' -- it should be 'staff'.

description: Edge: Product Manager IC -> senior (crossover rule)
input:
Title: Product Manager
Company: Nimbus AI
URL: https://nimbus.example/careers/pm

Join Nimbus AI as a Product Manager for our API platform. You'll own the developer experience and work with engineering to ship features that millions of developers use.

Requirements:
- 5+ years product management
- Technical background with API/platform products
- Experience with AI/ML products preferred

Location: San Francisco (hybrid - 3 days in office)
notes: Product Manager defaults to senior per crossover rules (PM title implies ownership scope). Not mid despite no 'Senior' prefix.

description: Edge: location listed but no remote/hybrid keywords -> unknown
input:
Title: Senior Customer Success Manager
Company: Vantage Pay
URL: https://vantagepay.example/careers/sr-csm

Vantage Pay is hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager to own retention and expansion for our enterprise payments clients.

Requirements:
- 7+ years in customer success or account management
- Experience in fintech or financial services
- Gainsight proficiency

Compensation: $140,000 - $170,000
Locations: Austin, TX | Denver, CO
notes: Office locations listed but no remote/hybrid keywords -> should be 'unknown' per extraction rules. Common model mistake is to say 'onsite'. Senior in title + 7+ years -> senior.

description: Edge: Director of Customer Experience = principal seniority
input:
Title: Director of Customer Experience
Company: Riverstone CRM
URL: https://riverstone.example/careers/director-cx

Riverstone CRM is looking for a Director of Customer Experience to build and lead our global CX function. You'll define the CX vision, manage a team of 15+, and report to the Chief Customer Officer.

Requirements:
- 10+ years in CX or customer success
- 5+ years in senior leadership roles

Location: Remote (global)
notes: Director = principal per management-track rules. Tests that models don't default to 'senior' for Director-level titles.

description: Edge: VP of Customer Strategy = executive seniority
input:
Title: VP of Customer Strategy
Company: Meridian Financial
URL: https://meridianfin.example/careers/vp-customer-strategy

Meridian Financial is seeking a VP of Customer Strategy to define and execute our long-term customer engagement and retention approach. You'll report directly to the CEO and lead a department of 30+.

Requirements:
- 15+ years in CX, customer success, or strategy
- 7+ years in executive leadership
- Fintech or financial services experience preferred

Compensation: $250,000 - $320,000 + equity
Location: San Francisco (hybrid - 2 days in office)
notes: VP = executive per management-track rules. Tests the top of the seniority spectrum.

description: Edge: CX role at AI company -> domain ambiguity
input:
Title: Customer Experience Manager
Company: Synthate AI
URL: https://synthate.example/careers/cx-manager

Synthate AI builds enterprise AI platforms for natural language understanding. We're hiring a Customer Experience Manager to lead CX for our growing enterprise segment.

Requirements:
- 5+ years in CX or customer success at a B2B tech company
- Experience with AI/ML products is a strong plus

Compensation: $140,000 - $170,000 + equity
Location: Remote (US/Canada)
notes: Synthate AI is an AI company, but the role is CX. Domain should follow company's primary domain (AI/ML), but 'SaaS' is also acceptable since it's a B2B platform. Tests domain resolution when company domain != role function.
